questions.q: Which of these is listed as a legitimate reason to self-host a model?
options: Data residency requirements that legally keep data on your own infrastructure
A vague preference for 'more control' with no specific requirement
Wanting to avoid writing any code at all
Needing the cheapest possible option regardless of scale
questions.explain: Data residency is one of the four legitimate reasons to self-host, alongside offline/edge environments, deep customization, and extreme sustained scale.

questions.q: What hidden cost of self-hosting does the lesson call out first?
options: The need for an ongoing MLOps team to patch, scale, and monitor the stack
A one-time setup fee charged by Microsoft
Mandatory annual retraining of every model
A licensing fee paid to the cloud AI platform
questions.explain: Self-hosting requires a standing MLOps responsibility — patching, scaling, and monitoring — that doesn't show up on the GPU invoice itself.

questions.q: According to the lesson, what happens to owned GPU hardware whether you use it or not?
options: It automatically gets resold at full price
It depreciates
It becomes more valuable over time
Microsoft refunds the cost
questions.explain: Owned hardware depreciates over time regardless of utilization, which is one of the hidden costs of the self-hosted path.

questions.q: In the decision checklist, what happens if none of the self-hosting conditions (on-prem requirement, offline, architecture changes, sustained scale) apply?
options: The model simply can't be deployed
You default to using a cloud AI platform
You must self-host anyway as a precaution
You flip a coin
questions.explain: The checklist treats the cloud AI platform as the correct default when none of the specific self-hosting conditions apply.

questions.q: Who is responsible for uptime when you self-host a model, as opposed to using a cloud AI platform?
options: Microsoft, under a standard SLA
No one — self-hosted models never go down
Your own team, since there's no managed SLA behind a self-hosted stack
The model's original training data provider
questions.explain: Self-hosting means there's no managed SLA; your own team owns uptime and has to respond to outages directly.
